title: eleocharis capitata var. typica
intro: Eleocharis capitata var. typica, commonly known as Spike-rush, is a type of flowering plant in the sedge family. It is used in traditional medicine and is valued for its health benefits, which include anti-inflammatory and antimicrobial properties that may help to reduce fever and alleviate respiratory issues. The therapeutic actions of Spike-rush include expectorant, anti-inflammatory, and antiseptic properties, which may aid in the relief of coughs, colds, and skin infections. The bioactive constituents of this plant include essential oils, flavonoids, and phenolic acids, although further research is needed to fully understand its pharmacological effects.
